title: Source
description: A provenance-bearing reference: either an internal repository file/section, or an external URL cited by a document. Every Document, Entity and Relationship record must be traceable to at least one Source.

source_id.description: Stable identifier for this source record, e.g. 'source:<sha1(url)[:10]>' for external links or 'doc:<front-matter id>' for internal documents.

kind.description: Whether this source is a file inside this repository or an external URL.

source_url.description: Public URL. For internal documents, the SAP Architecture Center public URL (https://architecture.learning.sap.com/docs<slug>). For external links, the literal URL found in the markdown.

source_file.description: Repository-relative path of the file this source was extracted from, e.g. docs/ref-arch/RA0029/1-a2a-and-mcp/readme.md.

source_section.description: Markdown heading (## ...) under which the source/link/evidence was found. null is reserved for facts with no body-text location at all (front matter fields, folder membership). Any evidence taken from the document BODY that precedes the first level 2-4 heading must use the literal string '__introduction__' instead of null (see config/ontology.yaml introduction_section_marker).

domain_category.description: Only present when kind = external_link. Domain classification per FASE 6 rules. 'SAP.com' covers www.sap.com corporate/marketing pages and any other *.sap.com subdomain not matched by a more specific rule. 'SAP BTP Hosted App' covers customer/demo apps hosted on *.hana.ondemand.com (including *.cfapps.<region>.hana.ondemand.com Cloud Foundry app routes) - these are SAP-hosted but not documentation, so kept distinct from 'SAP Help'/'SAP Discovery Center'. Classification never inspects or stores URL query parameters or credentials; only the hostname is used.

link_title.description: Markdown link text / anchor text as written in the source document.

evidence.description: Verbatim quoted text (sentence, list item, or markdown link) proving this source's relevance. Never empty.

repository_commit.description: Full git SHA of the commit the extraction was run against.
